comparison.objective: Dispense exactly ten selected tablets from a counting tray into a held vial.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tray tipping and vial positioning with granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: All ten counted tablets enter while vial is raised; six others remain, with no spill or loss.
comparison.reason: It shares complete accounting and containment of small loose objects, but tests controlled pouring of pre-existing tablets, not creation of fragments by aligned impact while protecting retained hardware.
